subject: PO intake — invoice cutoff policy, onboarding checklist, and early-pay fallback
messages:
From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ledgerly.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: accounts@ledgerly.com
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor setup + invoice cutoff and early-pay option

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the quick onboarding kick-off yesterday. We're finishing our supplier intake and want to align on two things before we submit invoices:

1) Invoice cutoff timing — Ledgerly batches invoices on the 5th and 20th of each month. Can Redwood confirm which cutoff lane our invoices will be routed to once the PO is active? We want to avoid late posting.

2) Early-pay option — our finance team would like to opt into an early-pay program for Net 45 invoices with a small fee. Can you share the process to request early settlement and whether Redwood supports per-vendor pilot exceptions?

Attached: preliminary vendor profile and our W‑9.

Appreciate any checklist or PO header requirements to avoid rejections.

Best,
Marcus Hale\Finance Operations\Ledgerly
[Attachment: Ledgerly_W9.pdf (PDF)]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ledgerly.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice cutoff and early-pay option

Marcus —

Great to meet you virtually. Short answers up front, details below:

- Cutoff lanes: We have two invoice ingestion lanes for new vendors (monthly 1–15 and 16–end). We'll route Ledgerly to the 1–15 lane by default to match your 5th batch.
- Early-pay: We run limited early-pay pilots per Finance approval. Please submit the attached onboarding form and indicate the preferred early-pay cadence; Finance will review.

I've attached our PO intake checklist and vendor onboarding form. Please fill and return.

Requests for clarity:
- Invoice header must include PO number, vendor remit email, and invoice URN (format: RDW-<vendor>-<yyMMDD>-NN).
- If you plan to use consolidated invoices, note that in the form; consolidated files sometimes delay matching.

Looping in David from Finance to confirm the pilot criteria and any required fees.

Thanks,
Irene Choi\Vendor Programs Manager\Redwood Inference\Phone: +1 415-555-0182
[Attachment: vendor_onboarding_form.pdf (PDF); PO_intake_checklist.docx (DOCX)]

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ledgerly.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 13:27:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice cutoff and early-pay option

Marcus / Irene —

Thanks for the context. A few clarifying items from Finance before we kick the early-pay review:

1) Eligibility: early-pay pilots require (a) vendor on net-45 or longer terms, (b) electronic invoice delivery to invoices@redwoodinference.com, and (c) a minimum 60‑day trade history with invoice samples or a signed MPA for new suppliers. Since Ledgerly is new, we'll treat this as a pilot with a 3‑month performance review.

2) Fees: typical early-pay fee bands range from 0.4% to 1.2% depending on days accelerated. We can provide exact bands after we see the invoice cadence and average invoice size.

3) PO header & URN validation: please ensure your AP system can populate the invoice URN as a separate field (not in memo). If you can send a sample invoice (PDF), that speeds validation.

Marissa — can Procurement confirm PO activation SLA for new vendors and whether we can use a temporary PO number to prevent invoices from bouncing during setup?

Thanks,
David Kim\Director, Finance Operations\Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ledgerly.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice cutoff and early-pay option

David / Irene —

Thanks — attached is a sample invoice (single invoice PDF) showing our standard header. We can add the RDW URN as a separate reference field; our billing system supports custom fields.

We agree to the 3‑month performance trial. For expected invoice size, most months are $40–80k; occasional spikes to $120k. Early-pay cadence request: target 10‑day settlement from receipt for a subset of invoices (pilot pool).

Attached: sample_invoice_081026.pdf, updated onboarding form with consolidated-invoice flag turned off.

Regards,
Marcus
[Attachments: sample_invoice_081026.pdf (PDF); vendor_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (PDF); Ledgerly_W9.pdf (PDF)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Hale <marcus.hale@ledgerly.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor setup + invoice cutoff and early-pay option

All —

Procurement confirms: we can issue a temporary PO (PO-TEMP-LEDG-1126) to prevent early invoice rejects while vendor profile completes. Permanent PO activation SLA is 5 business days after receipt of completed onboarding form and signed tax docs.

Regarding early-pay: approved to enter Ledgerly into a 3‑month pilot for up to 15 invoices per month, subject to Finance fee schedule. Please note the operational steps:

- Marcus: send invoices to invoices@redwoodinference.com with the RDW URN in a dedicated field.
- Irene: update vendor record and set invoice lane to 1–15 (aligns to Ledgerly's 5th batch).
- David: provide fee bands and execution method (AP push or third‑party factoring) by EOD Wednesday.

I'll attach the draft early-pay pilot agreement for signature; Marcus, please review and return with any legal redlines.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole\Senior Procurement Manager\Redwood Inference
[Attachment: earlypay-pilot-agreement-draft.pdf (PDF)]
